entities.title: Shared daemon
entities.summary: Both ends of the per-user daemon: the server that holds one engine for every session, the client side that serve uses to start it, greet it and pipe standard input and output through it, and the status, stop and restart commands.
entities.purpose: Holds DaemonServer, which listens on a unix socket in the state directory, attaches each client's roots, runs one MCP session per connection and answers the status and stop commands; Proxy, which connects (spawning the daemon when nothing answers), performs the handshake and copies bytes both ways; and Control, which asks the daemon about itself, makes it drain, kills it after a timeout and starts a fresh one.
boundaries: The MCP protocol itself is src/Mcp/; the daemon only frames a session with a one-line handshake.
Which process is a daemon and which is a client is decided in src/Program.cs (the daemon and serve commands).
